en_title: John Goodman, Laura Bailey, and Ian Alexander to Star in HBO's The Last of Us Season 3
cn_title: 《最后生还者》第三季公布阵容
subtitle: 或许真的是最终季
opus_summary: HBO公布《最后生还者》第三季演员阵容，John Goodman将饰演原创角色Joey，Ian Alexander出演Paco。

paragraphs.en: Emmy-winning actor John Goodman, prolific voice talent Laura Bailey, and returning star Ian Alexander have been cast in the third (and possibly final) season of HBO’s The Last of Us series.
paragraphs.cn: 艾美奖得主John Goodman、配音演员Laura Bailey，以及回归出演的Ian Alexander，将加盟HBO剧集《最后生还者》第三季。这可能也是该剧的最终季。

paragraphs.en: As revealed on September 26 — the day the Cordyceps infection ravaged humanity in The Last of Us universe — the show’s third season will feature three big talents, two of whom are making their return to Naughty Dog’s flagship zombie franchise.
paragraphs.cn: 9月26日公布的演员阵容中，有三位实力派将出演第三季。其中两人曾参与顽皮狗旗下的《最后生还者》系列。这个日期也正是《最后生还者》世界观中真菌感染席卷人类的日子。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps most surprisingly, John Goodman has been slated to play a character named Joey, a figure who wasn’t in the original games. Joey is joined by another character named Paco, who will be played by Ian Alexander; the two are described as a “friendly duo who dub themselves ‘Heroes of the Highway.’” Alexander notably played Lev in The Last of Us Part 2 , a young boy who Abby helps rescue from the Seraphite cult.
paragraphs.cn: 最令人意外的或许是，John Goodman将饰演名为Joey的角色；这个角色并未出现在原作游戏中。Ian Alexander则将饰演另一名角色Paco。两人被描述为一对友好的搭档，自称「公路英雄」。Alexander曾在《最后生还者2》中饰演Lev。游戏里，艾比帮助这名男孩逃离疤脸帮。

paragraphs.en: The Seraphites will play a part in season 3, as Laura Bailey is set to play Elizabeth, one of the cult’s leaders. Bailey is also a returning actor to the franchise, having famously voiced Abby in The Last of Us Part 2 alongside Alexander.
paragraphs.cn: 疤脸帮也将在第三季登场，Laura Bailey将饰演该团体的领袖之一Elizabeth。Bailey同样是回归出演，她曾在《最后生还者2》中为艾比配音，与Alexander共同参与该作。

paragraphs.en: With the Seraphites being included in the third season and Alexander playing a new character, it stands to reason that another person will be playing Lev, most likely because Alexander has aged out of the role.
paragraphs.cn: 第三季将引入疤脸帮，而Alexander又会改演新角色，因此很可能会有另一位演员饰演Lev。Alexander很可能是因为年龄增长，已不再适合出演这个角色。

paragraphs.en: These two aren’t the only actors from the original games who have been included in HBO’s screen adaptation; Ashley Johnson and Troy Baker also played characters in The Last of Us Season 1, with Johnson playing Ellie’s mother in a harrowing birth scene and Baker playing James, a member of Baker’s villainous group.
paragraphs.cn: HBO剧集改编版还邀请了另外两位曾参与原作游戏的演员：Ashley Johnson和Troy Baker都在《最后生还者》第一季中出演了角色。Johnson在一场令人揪心的分娩戏中饰演艾莉的母亲；Baker则饰演了由其角色所在的反派团伙成员James。

paragraphs.en: Johnson and Baker famously provided the voice and motion performances for Ellie and Joel in both of The Last of Us Games, so it’s not surprising that Bailey and Alexander are also showing up in some way.
paragraphs.cn: Johnson和Baker曾在《最后生还者》两部游戏中分别为艾莉和乔尔配音并进行动作捕捉，因此Bailey和Alexander也以某种形式参与其中并不奇怪。

paragraphs.en: HBO’s The Last of Us series is expected to end with this forthcoming season, which will air in 2027. In a September interview with Deadline, the Chairman and CEO of HBO and Max Content, Casey Bloys, said he “thinks [showrunner] Craig [Mazin] has planned it as the final season.”
paragraphs.cn: HBO剧集《最后生还者》预计将在即将播出的这一季完结，该季将于2027年播出。HBO和Max内容部门董事长兼首席执行官Casey Bloys在9月接受Deadline采访时表示，他「认为[剧集主创]Craig [Mazin]已将这一季规划为最终季」。

paragraphs.en: Bloys has been hinting at this since January, saying in another Deadline interview that “it certainly seems that way, but on decisions like that, we will defer to the showrunners. So you can ask them.”
paragraphs.cn: Bloys从今年1月起就一直在暗示这一点。他当时在另一场Deadline采访中表示：「看起来确实如此，但这类决定我们会交由剧集主创处理。你可以去问他们。」

paragraphs.en: With the games’ creator, Niel Druckmann, having left the project after Season 2, the future of HBO’s show is looking uncertain — but with talent like Alexander, Bailey, and Goodman on board, there’s bound to be some fantastic performances in store. We just hope they don’t tear our hearts apart like Nick Offerman did in the first season.
paragraphs.cn: 游戏创作者Niel Druckmann在第二季结束后离开了该项目，HBO剧集的未来因此显得不太明朗。不过，Alexander、Bailey和Goodman等演员加盟，观众肯定能看到精彩表演。我们只希望他们别像Nick Offerman在第一季那样，让观众心碎。
